categories.label: Access, setup & connectivity
categories.definition: Accounts, login, initial setup, device pairing, Wi-Fi and connection stability.
categories.excludes: App crashes without an explicit connection or account symptom.

categories.label: Controls & scheduling
categories.definition: Temperature adjustments, operating modes, schedules, vacation settings and remote control.
categories.excludes: Temperature readings without an adjustment request; physical equipment faults alone.

categories.label: Monitoring, alerts & energy
categories.definition: Status and temperature readings, notifications, energy usage, history and sensor information.
categories.excludes: Energy-saver mode selection, actual hot-water production, and temperature adjustment alone.

categories.label: App usability & reliability
categories.definition: Navigation, readability, responsiveness, crashes, software update problems and general app usability.
categories.excludes: An update mentioned only as background to a more specific functional symptom.

categories.label: Equipment performance
categories.definition: Customer-described physical heating/cooling outcomes, leaks, shutdowns and equipment faults.
categories.excludes: Merely naming a water heater, thermostat or HVAC product; no confirmed defect inference.
patterns: \b(?:cold shower\w*|cold bath\w*|cold water|no hot water|out of hot water|not heating|not cooling|leak\w*|shutoff|shutdown|overheat\w*)\b

categories.label: Support & service
categories.definition: Customer support, installer or technician service, warranties, manuals and documentation.
categories.excludes: A device supporting a feature; generic calls to fix the app.

categories.label: General / unclear
categories.definition: Broad praise, dissatisfaction, or text without a clear match to a specific subject.
categories.excludes: Explicit specific feedback covered by another category.
